description: Extractive abstention (slot rule v2, experimental, off by default): held-out results from the abstention rework. Benchmark test numbers also appear in final_abstain_summary.json.
provenance: Abstention rework judge decision and post-merge confirmation, 12 Oct 2026 (workflows wf_c1883e15-aea and wf_9916c4cd-315). Retrieval: hybrid_full, candidate pool 20, top-5. External sets were never used for tuning.
adoption_rule: default-on only if acceptance >= 95% (benchmark) / >= 90% (externals) and balanced accuracy beats no abstention by >= 3 points on both externals; neither design passed
